problem: a,b,c = construct_risos(), e = construct_mirror(b,c), h = construct_angle_mirror(b,c,a)
proof:
Solution:
1. Length_b_c - Length_c_e & Collinear(b,c,e) => Midpoint(c,b,e)
2. Angle_a_c_b - Angle_a_c_h & Angle_a_b_c - Angle_a_c_b => Angle_a_b_c - Angle_a_c_h
3. Perpendicular(a,b,a,c) => Angle_b_a_c - pi/2
4. Angle_a_b_c - Angle_a_c_h & Angle_a_b_c + Angle_a_c_b + Angle_b_a_c - pi & Angle_a_c_b + Angle_a_c_h - Angle_b_c_h & Angle_b_a_c - pi/2 => Angle_b_c_h - pi/2
5. Angle_b_c_h - pi/2 => Perpendicular(b,c,c,h)
6. Collinear(b,c,e) => Parallel(b,c,b,e)
7. Perpendicular(b,c,c,h) & Parallel(b,c,b,e) => Perpendicular(b,e,c,h)
8. Midpoint(c,b,e) & Perpendicular(b,e,c,h) => Length_b_h - Length_e_h
9. Length_b_h - Length_e_h => IsoscelesTriangle(b,e,h)
10. IsoscelesTriangle(b,e,h) & Length_b_h - Length_e_h & Collinear(b,c,e) & Perpendicular(b,e,c,h) => Angle_b_h_c - Angle_c_h_e
